verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting docs state it gives "Full control over data location". You can run it on any Docker host or your own Kubernetes cluster, and migrate between Cloud and self-hosted, so you can decide where your data lives. However, this residency control comes from running your own infrastructure; nothing in the pack shows region or residency selection on the managed Appwrite Cloud service. Missing for 10: documented region/residency choice on Appwrite Cloud, a list of available regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can install and run Appwrite on any operating system that can run a Docker CLI, or on your own Kubernetes cluster with the official Helm chart.
You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.
